scope: Real native codec and packedCreatureBodies decoder; admitted numeric evaluator, unchanged gait5 adapter and Three SkinnedMesh.applyBoneTransform. Local sampled envelopes, not world contact, rendering, combat or physical death acceptance.

measurement.scope: Diagnostic weighted rest measurement only; no candidate admission or collision acceptance

method.bodyHalfLen: Half of maximum absolute hull Z offset from body pivot
method.bodyRadius: Maximum body/belly-influenced vertex distance to symmetric Z segment plus 0.001 m; includes every positive influence across merged parts
method.headRadius: Maximum head-influenced vertex distance to head pivot plus 0.001 m; merged head envelope, not eye-only or anatomical fit
method.legLen: Body pivot Y minus lowest fin/toe vertex Y
method.feet: AABB X/Z centres of all positively fin-weighted vertices, ordered finL, finR, rearL, rearR
method.halfWidth: Maximum absolute X of all actual parts

limitations: Rest only; 1.05/1.10 inflation containment and collider response untested
Conservative capsule includes empty space and may feel oversized
Eye sphere is not a full head hit-volume design
No visual, fight, terrain, balance or phone acceptance
Weight-based envelopes can include non-anatomical regions; rest bind weights do not prove inflation containment
